pagamenti.termini: The consultant is paid when the client leaves a review, if there is no open dispute. If no review is left, the payout is sent 48 hours after the consultation ends.
pagamenti.faq: Payments are handled by Stripe and PayPal. With automatic confirmation the amount is charged when you pay. With manual confirmation by the consultant a pre-authorization is placed, and the charge is made when the consultant accepts. The consultant's payout is released when the client leaves a review, if no dispute is open. If the review does not arrive, the payout is released 48 hours after the consultation ends.
pagamenti.incassi: The payout reaches your Stripe or PayPal account when the client leaves a review. If the review does not arrive, it is sent 48 hours after the end, provided there is no open dispute. Ispiramy keeps a 20% commission on the consultation price. The service fee is not part of the payout.

faq.intro: Answers to the most common questions about bookings, payments and consultations.
faq.come_prenoto: How do I book a consultation?
faq.come_prenoto_b: open the profile, choose a date, a length and an available time, and complete the payment. Confirmation is sent by email.
faq.durata_testo: The minimum length is 60 minutes. When you book you can choose 60, 90 or 120 minutes.
faq.video: How does the video call work?
faq.video_testo: The consultation takes place on the platform, in the built-in video call: you do not install another program. If recording was chosen when booking, the call is recorded. A reminder is sent before the appointment.
faq.annulla: Can I cancel or get a refund?
faq.annulla_testo: If recording was chosen when you booked, the call is recorded and you can open a dispute within 48 hours after the end. The people who verify profiles and the people who administer the site review the video, also with the help of an automatic analysis. If the dispute is accepted, the client is refunded the cost of the consultation, not the service fee of {n} €. Without a recording, a dispute is not available. If you cancel in time, or if the consultant does not attend, the refund also includes the service fee.
faq.diventa: How do I become a consultant?
faq.diventa_testo: Register, complete your profile with your skills and experience, and set your rate and availability. Once the profile has been verified, you can receive bookings.
faq.altro_b: the request is read by support.
